 GuruFocus News Mon, November 2, 2026 at 5:17 AM MST 2 min read MCX.NS -6.08% 
 MCX.BO -2.73% 
 This article first appeared on GuruFocus . 
 Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) is set to release its Q2 2027 earnings on Nov 3, 2026. The consensus estimate for Q2 2027 revenue is 7.70 billion, and the earnings are expected to come in at 18.70 per share. The full year 2027's revenue is expected to be 29.78 billion and the earnings are expected to be 68.16 per share. More detailed estimate data can be found on the Forecast page . 
 Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) Estimates Trends

 Over the past 90 days, revenue estimates for Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) have declined from 29.79 billion to 29.78 billion for the full year 2027, while they have increased from 34.73 billion to 34.99 billion for 2028. During the same period, earnings estimates have declined from 68.97 per share to 68.16 per share for the full year 2027, and from 80.86 per share to 80.56 per share for 2028. 
 Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd (NSE:MCX`)` Reported History 
 In the previous quarter of 2026-03-31, Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd's ( NSE:MCX ) actual revenue was 8.89 billion, which beat analysts' revenue expectations of 6.43 billion by 38.16%. Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd's ( NSE:MCX ) actual earnings were 20.78 per share, which beat analysts' earnings expectations of 17.85 per share by 16.44%. After releasing the results, Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) was up by 1.81% in one day. 
 Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) 12 Month Price Targets 
 Based on the one-year price targets offered by 15 analysts, the average target price for Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) is 3504.93 with a high estimate of 4000.00 and a low estimate of 2825.00. The average target implies an upside of 9.91% from the current price of 3188.80. 
 Based on GuruFocus estimates, the estimated GF Value for Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd ( NSE:MCX ) in one year is 3853.09, suggesting an upside of 20.83% from the current price of 3188.80. 
 Based on the consensus recommendation from 16 brokerage firms, Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd's ( NSE:MCX ) average brokerage recommendation is currently 1.80, indicating an "Outperform" status. The rating scale ranges from 1 to 5, where 1 signifies Strong Buy, and 5 denotes Sell.
